wholePhysicalScope: Named Arsenal House High and Low Blocks share one mapped boundary at 1 Arsenal Street. The tall and low commissioned masses match the architectural department’s public description.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the Arsenal House silhouette and varied curtain-wall elevations.
limitations: Exteriors of the 2004 High and Low Blocks only. Earlier East and West Wings, Caine House and neighboring structures are outside this scope.
The tower height and building outlines are evidence-based. The parapet heights, trim, glass module and sheen, low-block roof height, and street-level bay proportions are estimates.
All geometry depicts the public skyline and visible cladding only. The low block is an approximate simple stepped mass.
